en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

...Huh, why do you want to do something
so childish? For a prank?

I may be liked by children,
but that doesn't mean I'm a child myself.

I wouldn't mind that.
Sweet things calm me.

I'm still way too soft to be an assassin...
But it's okay for me to like sweets, right?
At least I finish what needs to be done...

Hey, wipe that smirk off your face!
Don't make fun of me!

Starvation is one of the most painful ways
to die in the world.

...Kidding.
But no seriously, don't do it.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Maki looks deep in thought...
